title: chore(dependencies): remove unused
body:
* classnames: only used in two little examples and no longer properly declared: removed
* some storybook addons only used in react
* enzyme adaptors only used in react
* glob: used in an old version of the react website
* puppeteer: used in previous tests of react storybook (that didn't run anymore for a while)
* babel plugin that no longer is used
* jscodeshift that isn't used globally
* react-error-boundary that was only used in React InstantSearch (not even sure if it was)
